text:
maya (partnerships): Quick thought — proposal for a HW co-sell private offer that helps close larger committed deals but keeps renewals simple. Draft below, want quick reactions.
aj (enterprise-sales): curious. TL;DR?
maya (partnerships): TL;DR: 3-tier committed spend ladder + onboarding SI credit + 1st-year renewal discount taper. Aim: reduce friction for enterprise HW partners to resell Redwood Dedicated.
ben (product): will the tiers map to Dedicated capacity SKUs or to token spend?
maya (partnerships): map to reserved capacity SKUs. tiers = small/medium/large (4, 12, 48 GPU-month equiv). We can expose a price per-GPU-month and an "HW uplift" percent for co-sell credit.
jenna (solutions): onboarding credit idea is great — we should specify it as an SI services credit (not cash) to avoid invoicing headaches. Example: first 3 months of SI hours covered up to $X.
claire (finance): preference for credits applied on invoice as zero-dollar line item. Keeps ARR math clean. Need exact burn rules and expiry (recommend 6 months).
sam (legal): also add clause: credits non-transferable, applied only to Redwood-managed invoices for the committed account. Side note: we need to confirm any marketplace private-offer constraints per cloud provider.
maya (partnerships): good call. Cloud marketplaces may require private-offer mechanics for reserved SKUs — we should coordinate with marketplace team. I'll ping them.
aj (enterprise-sales): renewal cadence: if partner brings renewal, do we keep same tier pricing? or auto-step-down? customers push back if price changes.
maya (partnerships): propose renewal taper: Year 2 = -5% off Year1 net, Year 3 = -2% off Year2 net, unless customer upsizes. Purpose: reward commitment but not lock discounts forever.
ben (product): operational question: to support tiered tiers we need to tag instances for partner attribution + reporting. Solutions/console changes might be needed. Jenna: estimate effort?
jenna (solutions): ~2 sprints to add partner attribution metadata in provisioning + billing flag to surface in console. Also need onboarding flow for SI credit redemption.
claire (finance): also need clear SKU mapping in private-offer payload for marketplace (product id + term). I'll draft mapping if you confirm the 3 tiers.
sam (legal): I'll draft the credit/legal text. One more ask: we should include an escape clause for unforeseen HW shortages (force majeure style) and fallback to hosted variants at comparable price.
maya (partnerships): noted. One more marketing/announce question: partners want a joint announcement window. propose: partner co-sell launch = partner enablement complete + 30 days buffer for marketplace listing. announce-bot: Scheduled: mothership/announce channel will post once "partner marque" tag is set and legal sign-off done.
aj (enterprise-sales): timeline check: if we finalize terms this week can we onboard a pilot partner in 6 weeks?
jenna (solutions): 6 weeks is doable if finance/legal have draft terms in 1 week and we prioritize console work.
claire (finance): I'll put draft SKU mapping + credit expiry rules in shared doc by EOD tomorrow.
sam (legal): I'll aim to have the SOW/credit language by next Tue.
maya (partnerships): Awesome. Action items: 1) Claire: SKU mapping + credit rules (EOD tomorrow). 2) Sam: legal language (next Tue). 3) Jenna: estimate + prioritization for console/prov (this week). 4) Ben: confirm partner attribution hook and acceptance criteria. 5) AJ: shortlist pilot partner and confirm co-sell playbook. I'll coordinate marketplace team.
aj (enterprise-sales): ack. will share shortlist today.
jenna (solutions): ack.
ben (product): ack — will validate hook by Fri.
claire (finance): ack.
sam (legal): ack.
maya (partnerships): thanks all. If anyone has major objections to the taper/credit model speak now or DM me. Otherwise i'll fold this into the PO draft and loop in marketplace ops. :thumbsup:
